s1.title: Your pulse in the scene
s1.desc: Consecutive weeks out and recent dances — your real activity, no rankings. The full detail lives in your Profile.

s2.title: Going out tonight?
s2.desc: The night at a glance: honest pricing, friends going and presales left. If you already have a ticket, your QR is one tap away.

s3.title: Social ↔ Academy
s3.desc: Two worlds in one app: Social for events, dances and friends; Academy for classes and your learning. Switch it here.

s4.title: The bell
s4.desc: Everything lands here: gifted tickets, confirmed table reservations, friend requests and notices from your events.

s5.title: The lineup
s5.desc: All of Santiago's socials: filter by style or venue, check the map, buy your presale and book a table for your group.

s6.title: The + button
s6.desc: Your QR — your ticket at the door and how you log dances on the floor — plus your Dances history and the community's Practices.

s7.title: Your profile
s7.desc: Photo, styles you dance, your details, payments and language. If you're also an instructor, DJ, producer or run an academy, switch lens here.

s1.title: Your learning
s1.desc: Attendance, classes taken and your progress as a student, at a glance.

s2.title: Your upcoming classes
s2.desc: What you've already booked: open the detail for the schedule, the instructor and cancellation if you can't make it.

s3.title: Social ↔ Academy
s3.desc: You're in Academy mode. Go back to Social for the events lineup, your dances and your people.

s4.title: The bell
s4.desc: Notices land here: class bookings, confirmations and news from your academies.

s5.title: Classes
s5.desc: Your academies and the whole scene under Explore: book your spot, check your history and your private lessons.

s6.title: The + button
s6.desc: Your personal QR: it's also your credential to mark attendance in class.

s7.title: Academies
s7.desc: The scene's directory: discover academies, see their classes and enroll. If you're already in one, My Learning lives here.

s1.title: Filter by style
s1.desc: Salsa, bachata or timba? Tap a chip to see only those nights. You can combine several.

s2.title: By venue
s2.desc: Fan of a place? See only its lineup and open its profile for the address and directions.

s3.title: Three ways to see
s3.desc: List by day, monthly calendar or venue map: choose how to explore the scene.

s4.title: My events
s4.desc: Your agenda and wallet: the nights where you already have a ticket, with its QR, gifts and payments under review.

s5.title: Tap an event
s5.desc: Each card opens the detail: lineup, plan of the night and prices. In checkout you can gift tickets to your people or book a table.

s1.title: List or calendar
s1.desc: Classes grouped by day or the full month in calendar — choose how to look at the week.

s2.title: What to look at
s2.desc: My classes are your academies'; Explore shows the whole scene; History keeps what you've already taken.

s3.title: Explore academies
s3.desc: All the scene's classes, not just your academies'. Booking requires an active enrollment.

s4.title: Filter your way
s4.desc: Style, level and academy — and inside My classes you can switch between All and just your Booked ones.

s5.title: Book in one tap
s5.desc: Each card shows the time and the spots left. If it fills up, you join the waitlist.

s1.title: Your personal QR
s1.desc: It renews itself so nobody can copy it. At the door it's your ticket; on the floor, it logs dances with your partner.

s2.title: Scanner mode
s2.desc: Switch to Scan to log a dance with your partner's QR. It lands in your Dances history.

s3.title: Save it to your wallet
s3.desc: Add the pass to Google Wallet and open your QR straight at the door, no hunting for the app.

s1.title: Build your people
s1.desc: Search them by name or share your invite link — whoever opens it lands straight on adding you.

s2.title: Your friends are going to
s2.desc: The events where someone from your people already has a ticket, so you don't hit the floor alone.

s3.title: Requests
s3.desc: Requests that reach you are accepted here; the ones you sent show further down.

s4.title: Your list
s4.desc: Open a friend's profile to see their styles and which events they're going to. In checkout you can gift them tickets.

s1.title: To confirm
s1.desc: The night's live dance invites: accept them or let them pass, without anyone knowing.

s2.title: Your last social
s2.desc: How many dances, how many different partners, your average and the best dance of the night: your retrospective.

s3.title: Your history
s3.desc: All your nights grouped by event: who took you out to dance, who you rated and how much you danced.

s1.title: All or yours
s1.desc: Switch between all the community's practices and only the ones you organize or attend.

s2.title: By style
s2.desc: Only timba today? Tap a chip to filter; tap it again to clear.

s3.title: Create yours
s3.desc: Getting together to train, reviewing a class or a warm-up before the social? Create your practice with spots and a place.

s4.title: The practices
s4.desc: Grouped by day: time, place, who's hosting and how many are going. Tap one to confirm you're in.

s1.title: Your identity
s1.desc: Photo, name and Instagram: what your friends and dance partners see. Your details and the app's language are edited inside.

s2.title: Your activity
s2.desc: All the insights for your lens: streak, points, dances or attendance, depending on Social or Academy.

s3.title: Act as
s3.desc: Switch the whole app's lens: dancer, staff, producer, academy… the nav and home transform.

s4.title: Your streak
s4.desc: Consecutive weeks on the floor — or in class if you're in Academy mode. It's earned by showing up.

s5.title: Badges
s5.desc: Achievements for real behavior, always private: no public ranking, no comparing to anyone.

s6.title: Your payments
s6.desc: The history of what you bought in the app: tickets, class bookings and charges.

s1.title: Your month at a glance
s1.desc: Scheduled events, tickets sold, monthly billing and pending collections: the pulse of your production.

s2.title: Receipts to review
s2.desc: Transfers, payment links and cash waiting for your sign-off: approving issues the ticket. The full queue lives in Receipts.

s3.title: Your best nights
s3.desc: Top 5 by billing and by attendance: which date worked and which is worth repeating.

s4.title: Your events
s4.desc: Create and manage every event: prices, lineup, reservable tables, guest lists, passes and comps, door staff and academies selling your presale on commission.

s5.title: All the modules
s5.desc: Receipts, discount codes, door collaborators, CRM and analytics; plus your settings - defaults, payment methods, payouts, Pro subscription and appearance - all from the menu.

s6.title: The bell
s6.desc: Every ticket sale and every new receipt lands here. Nothing slips by.

s1.title: Your week
s1.desc: The classes you teach, your next 7 days and the attendance marked: your operation at a glance.

s2.title: Upcoming classes
s2.desc: What's ahead with its quorum: bookings vs capacity. Tap one to open the roster and mark attendance.

s3.title: My classes
s3.desc: Your console: each class's full roster. You can mark present from 30 minutes before until 30 after it starts.

s4.title: Students
s4.desc: Find them by name and check their attendance history: quick read, no editing.

s5.title: The bell
s5.desc: We let you know when you're assigned a class, and 30 and 10 minutes before each one.

s6.title: Your profile
s6.desc: Photo, details and your lenses: if you also dance or have another role, switch views here.

s1.title: Your academy in numbers
s1.desc: Active students, plans on sale, this week's classes, attendance and monthly revenue, with the change vs last month. Each number opens its module.

s2.title: Today's operation
s2.desc: Today's classes with their bookings and marked attendance. Tap one to open its roster.

s3.title: To review
s3.desc: Payment receipts to validate and private lessons to schedule: the queue worth clearing every day.

s4.title: What's coming
s4.desc: Plans about to expire and student birthdays: retaining and celebrating is also operations.

s5.title: All modules
s5.desc: Students, classes, private lessons, plans, payments, team and settings: each card opens its section based on your access.

s6.title: Also in the menu
s6.desc: The same modules live in the side menu and, depending on your role, the academy's CRM and Analytics.

s7.title: The bell
s7.desc: Notifications land here: new receipts, requests and news from your academy.

s1.title: Your month at a glance
s1.desc: Active students, sellable plans, weekly classes, attendance and billed, with the comparison against last month.

s2.title: Getting started
s2.desc: The activation checklist: schedule, plan, payment method, team and first student. It disappears on its own once the academy is ready.

s3.title: Today's operation
s3.desc: Today's classes with their bookings and marked attendance. Tap a class to see its roster.

s4.title: The urgent
s4.desc: Receipts to validate and private lessons to confirm: the queue worth bringing to zero each day.

s5.title: What's coming
s5.desc: Plans expiring and your students' birthdays: retaining and celebrating is also operation.

s6.title: All the modules
s6.desc: Series, private lessons, students, payments, CRM and analytics Queries: everything grouped by section in the side menu.

s7.title: The bell
s7.desc: Notices land here: new receipts, requests and news from your academy.

s1.title: Pick your night
s1.desc: The scene's published and live events. Tap yours and you land straight in the door console.

s2.title: The menu
s2.desc: From here you reach the lineup and your profile: staff at the door, dancer on the floor.

s3.title: The bell
s3.desc: Scene notices land here: tickets, friends and news from your events.

s1.title: Point and done
s1.desc: The camera reads the QR by itself: green is a valid entry, amber means no pass (they go in, but check) and red is a duplicate. The phone also vibrates.

s2.title: No QR? By name
s2.desc: Look them up in the event roster and check them in by hand. Works even when the signal drops.

s3.title: The night's counter
s3.desc: How many people are inside, including check-ins made offline: they sync on their own when the signal returns.

s4.title: Who's already in
s4.desc: The night's list with time and method; pending syncs and conflicts stay marked.

s5.title: Scanner ↔ list
s5.desc: Switch between the camera and the attendees with the tabs below, within thumb's reach.

s1.title: The queue first
s1.desc: All pending receipts at a glance: tap one to see the evidence and approve or reject - approving issues the ticket.

s2.title: The history
s2.desc: What's already resolved: who approved or rejected each payment and when. Full traceability.

s3.title: Filter the view
s3.desc: By status and by date, to cross-check a specific payment or review a period.

s1.title: Grow your team
s1.desc: Search by name or invite by email: whoever joins becomes available as door staff in all your events.

s2.title: Your roster
s2.desc: These people are the candidates when staffing each event's door. Here you only remove from the list.

s1.title: Your base in numbers
s1.desc: Active students and how enrollment is moving, compared with last month.

s2.title: Who stands out
s2.desc: Top by all-time attendance and by amount paid this month: each row opens the student's profile.

s3.title: Find who you're looking for
s3.desc: Filter by name, enrollment status or plan.

s4.title: The roster
s4.desc: Each card opens the profile: plan, validity, attendance and the relationship score, private to your academy.

s5.title: New enrollment
s5.desc: Enroll a student with their plan and validity from here.

s6.title: Bulk import
s6.desc: Bringing your list from another system? Upload it as CSV with the downloadable template.

s1.title: The month in money
s1.desc: Monthly revenue, average ticket and the payment methods your students use most, with their change.

s2.title: Plans expiring
s2.desc: Enrollments due today or this week: each row opens the profile to renew.

s3.title: Payments to validate
s3.desc: Receipts your students submitted: tap one to review it and approve or reject it in its detail.

s4.title: History
s4.desc: Every validation and gateway payment in order: the full trail of each charge.

s1.title: Find the class
s1.desc: Filter by academy, series or date: handy if you teach in more than one place.

s2.title: Your classes with quorum
s2.desc: Each card shows bookings vs quorum and the waitlist. Tap it to open the roster and mark attendance.

s1.title: The class
s1.desc: Series, style, level, date and who teaches it: the session's operative card.

s2.title: The quorum
s2.desc: Bookings vs the minimum capacity: the bar fills when the class is confirmed.

s3.title: Booked
s3.desc: Who holds a spot. The instructor marks present within the class window: 30 minutes before to 30 after it starts.

s4.title: Waitlist
s4.desc: In arrival order: if a spot frees up, the first one on the list gets in.

s1.title: Yours or to discover
s1.desc: My academies shows your enrollments with plan and attendance; Explore opens the full directory of the scene.

s2.title: List or map
s2.desc: Switch to map to see academies by location and find the one closest to you.

s3.title: Filter by style
s3.desc: Salsa, bachata, whatever you're after: the style filter applies to list and map; in Explore you can also search by name.

s4.title: Each card opens its page
s4.desc: Styles, address and instructors; the page shows their classes, plans and videos.

s1.title: Your audience, with a score
s1.desc: Each person gets a relationship score built from real activity - attendance, purchases, check-ins. It's private: only you see it. Tap a card to open their profile.

s2.title: Segments that move on their own
s2.desc: New, At risk, Brings people, Core: membership is recalculated automatically on every score recompute. Here you see how many you have in each.

s3.title: Search and filter
s3.desc: By name or tag, by segment - including the ones you save - and sort by score or by name.

s4.title: Bulk actions
s4.desc: Select the whole page or a few people to add or remove a tag, or send them a campaign together.

s5.title: More than one actor?
s5.desc: If you produce and also own an academy, each has its own audience: scores, segments and campaigns are computed separately. Switch here.

s6.title: Campaigns and triggers
s6.desc: From the menu: campaigns with a notification or a discount code - schedulable, with attribution of who came back and who redeemed - plus triggers that fire on their own by behavior.

s7.title: The bell
s7.desc: Your trigger digests and campaign send notices land here.

s1.title: Ready-made queries
s1.desc: The system's quick queries plus the ones you save: one tap preloads entity and filters.

s2.title: Pick what to query
s2.desc: Sales, check-ins, attendance, students, events… the entities depend on your active lens - switch it from your profile.

s3.title: Narrow it with filters
s3.desc: Dates, event, channel, academy: each entity brings its own filters, with quick ranges (today, 7 days, 30 days).

s4.title: Run and export
s4.desc: Apply to see the paged result; export it to CSV or PDF with the same filters.

s5.title: Save it to reuse
s5.desc: Give it a name and it lands in My queries: next time you preload it in one tap.

s6.title: Per-person analytics
s6.desc: As an admin you can view any user's activity by lens: it's in the menu, under Analytics.

s1.title: People and roles
s1.desc: Look up any user by name, email, phone or role. In their profile you approve pending roles, change their status or revoke them.

s2.title: The RBAC catalog
s2.desc: What each role can do: the permission catalog and which roles people can request.

s3.title: Platform parameters
s3.desc: Commissions, cooldowns and global limits: changes apply within seconds.

s4.title: Scheduled jobs
s4.desc: The platform's scheduled tasks - score recompute, digests, billing - with their schedule, runs and pause. You can run them manually.

s5.title: Catalogs
s5.desc: Dance styles, levels and class types: the building blocks behind classes and events across the app.

s6.title: The rest of the panel
s6.desc: Operations data, audit, finance, billing, mail campaigns and academy health - plus CRM and per-user analytics from the menu.

s1.title: More than one venue?
s1.desc: If you manage several, this selector switches venue: the whole board refreshes with its data.

s2.title: Your venue's lineup
s2.desc: The shows booked here, with their status. It's the same thing the public sees on your venue profile.

s3.title: Your month in numbers
s3.desc: Upcoming events, plus events and check-ins from the last 30 days - and above, your address and capacity.

s4.title: Table reservations
s4.desc: Who booked, party size and for which night. It's registration only: the sale runs through your POS.

s5.title: When it fills up
s5.desc: Arrivals by hour, peak hour and average stay over the last 30 days.

s6.title: Rentals
s6.desc: Academies request your venue by date: confirm or cancel each request right here.

s7.title: Your menus
s7.desc: Menu PDFs open in a new tab - always external links, nothing is hosted here.

s1.title: Find the user
s1.desc: Name or email: from 2 letters the search runs on its own. No bulk listings - every lookup is on demand.

s2.title: The profile sums it up
s2.desc: Pick a result to see their data, roles with status, latest tickets and latest payments - all read-only.

s3.title: Asked about an event?
s3.desc: The full lineup is one tap away to check dates, venues and prices while you reply.

s4.title: The bell
s4.desc: Platform and user notices land here - check it when your shift starts.
